title: Understanding the implications of dystonia on affect, cognition, daily life, and social relationships
summary:
The VIDA study examines how dystonia affects the lives of those affected. This includes concentration, memory, emotions, social relationships, self-image, daily functioning, and experiences with the healthcare system.

Participation takes place anonymously via an online or paper questionnaire. The goal of the study is to better understand the experiences of people with dystonia, identify gaps in healthcare services, and improve support options in the long term.

interventions.name: Individuals with diagnosed or suspected dystonia participate in a one-time anonymous online survey. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosed dystonia or suspected dystonia
Capacity to consent and informed consent
Age ≥ 18 years
Sufficient German language skills
Treatment in Germany
Exclusion criteria:
No diagnosed or suspected dystonia
Age < 18 years
Lack of capacity to consent or lack of informed consent
Insufficient German language skills
No treatment in Germany
